findings.issue: F7 facet concurrence: Authorization for citation retrieval only checks tenant/principal plus the generic foundry.rag.retrieve surface. It does not bind the authorization decision to namespace, capability_id, or search_index_id, so a broad surface grant can authorize citations for…
findings.remediation: Add decision-scope fields for namespace, capability_id, and search_index_id (or an equivalent signed authorization input hash), reject drift before retrieval, and add regression tests for cross-capability/index denial.
